facts.fact: Minister of SMEs Lydia Mikolo launched on 5 December 2025 a 100 percent online company-creation platform of the ACPCE, on which entrepreneurs file, track and pay fees online, with more than 5,300 firms created in 2025.

systems.owner: Agence congolaise pour la creation d'entreprises

COG.note: Document cites digitalisation as the fifth pillar of the 2022-2026 national development plan, a development-plan class, and a national digital transformation strategy without naming or describing it.
Document states nothing on tax filing or payment.
